summary: LCI Industries filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on May 12, 2026, announcing its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $1.15 per share, payable June 12, 2026, to holders of record May 29, 2026. The dividend is a routine recurring distribution with no stated premium, special terms, or structural changes such as a tender or return of capital event. There are no deal terms, advisors, or regulatory milestones to watch. This filing is an ordinary dividend announcement and does not constitute a special situation.
